query:
SELECT up.userId, u.email, up.module, up.accessLevel
FROM userPermissions up
JOIN users u ON u.id = up.userId
WHERE up.userId IN ('191','933743','933764','933919','4230011','12484156','12484157','12484158','12484159','12484160')
ORDER BY u.email, up.module;
